executiveSummary: Major trends in AI/ML, hardware, and industry shifts are emerging, with a focus on power, privacy, and accessibility. Apple's latest products and services are being scrutinized, and the company's roadmap for new Mac and iPad models is being revealed. The future of smartwatches and wearables is also being explored.

takeaways.title: AI/ML advancements
takeaways.description: Google launches AI voice features in Gmail, Docs, and Keep, and OpenAI's Astra model is gaining attention for its speed and accuracy. Ollie, a family-focused AI assistant, is betting on privacy to win the AI assistant race.

takeaways.title: Hardware releases
takeaways.description: Apple Vision Pro was used in a first-of-its-kind surgery, and the Moto Watch Ultra returns to Wear OS. Lenovo's new MacBook Neo competitor, the IdeaPad Vibe, is also being released.

takeaways.title: Industry shifts
takeaways.description: Apple is facing a £2.7 billion lawsuit over App Tracking Rules, and the company's roadmap for new Mac and iPad models is being revealed. The industry is shifting towards more powerful and accessible devices, with a focus on power and privacy.

worthWatching: Google's AI voice features in Gmail, Docs, and Keep will start feeding into weather information users see in search, Google Maps, and Gemini.
Apple's 2026 Studio Display is available for $1,684.88 with an on-page coupon, down from $1,899.00.
engineeringPerspective: The latest AI models, such as OpenAI's Astra, are being developed with a focus on speed, accuracy, and safety.
The use of solid-state cooling in laptops, such as Lenovo's Project AeroBlade, is becoming more prevalent and efficient.
